Done — I built a complete playable browser game in:

- /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html

What’s included:
- Medieval village world with houses, lakes, trees, roads, and a central settlement
- Merchant NPCs, villagers, animals, and monsters
- On-screen controls for movement and actions
- Quest loop: recover relics, talk to the elder, survive monsters, and win
- Start overlay and polished game HUD/interface

Controls:
- WASD / Arrow keys to move
- On-screen D-pad buttons for touch play
- Talk, Attack, and Potion buttons

Assumptions:
- I treated this as a lightweight top-down action/RPG prototype focused on world-building and playable loop rather than a large 3D game.
- The world is stylized and optimized for a single-page browser game.
